Brightwell Analytics - Employee Handbook
Version 4.2, effective 1 March 2026. Owner: People Operations.

All names, companies and figures in this document are fictional and were written as sample data for
DocQuery. Any resemblance to a real organisation is coincidental.

1. Welcome
Brightwell Analytics was founded in 2014 in Leeds and helps retailers forecast demand. We are about
180 people working across data science, engineering, sales and operations. This handbook explains
how we work together and what you can expect from us. If a rule here conflicts with your employment
contract, your contract wins.

2. Working hours
The standard working week is 37.5 hours. You can choose when to start and finish your day, but
everyone is expected to be available during core hours, from 10:00 to 15:00 UK time, Monday to
Friday. Meetings should not be scheduled outside core hours without the attendees' agreement.
Overtime is not paid for salaried staff; instead, extra hours worked at a manager's request can be
taken back as time off in lieu within the following two months.

Overtime is not paid for salaried staff; instead, extra hours worked at a manager's request can be
taken back as time off in lieu within the following two months.

3. Who to ask
Questions about pay, leave and contracts go to People Operations (people@brightwell.example).
Questions about laptops, accounts and access go to the IT Service Desk (it@brightwell.example).

4. Annual leave
Full-time employees receive 25 days of paid annual leave per year, in addition to UK public
holidays. Part-time employees receive the same entitlement pro rata.
After two full years of service, your entitlement increases by one day for each further full year
of service, up to a maximum of 30 days per year.
You may carry over up to 5 unused days into the next leave year. Carried-over days must be taken
by 31 March, after which they are lost. Leave requests are made in the HR portal and should be
submitted at least two weeks in advance for absences longer than three days.

5. Sick leave
If you are ill, tell your manager before 10:00 on your first day of absence. You can self-certify
sickness for up to 7 calendar days. For longer absences a fit note from a doctor is required.
Brightwell pays full salary for up to 20 working days of sickness in any rolling 12-month period;
after that, statutory sick pay applies.

For longer absences a fit note from a doctor is required.
Brightwell pays full salary for up to 20 working days of sickness in any rolling 12-month period;
after that, statutory sick pay applies.

6. Parental leave
The primary carer of a new child receives 26 weeks of parental leave at full pay, followed by up to
13 weeks at statutory pay. The secondary carer receives 4 weeks of parental leave at full pay,
which can be taken in one block or in separate weeks within the first year.

7. Remote and hybrid work
Brightwell is a hybrid company. Employees are expected in the office at least 2 days per week. Our
anchor days are Tuesday and Thursday, when teams plan and meet in person.
New starters receive a one-off home office allowance of 300 GBP for a chair, desk or monitor.
Receipts must be submitted as an expense claim within the first three months.

Working from abroad: you may work from another country for up to 20 working days per calendar
year. Each stay needs written approval from People Operations at least four weeks before you
travel, because of tax and data protection rules. Some countries are excluded for security reasons;
People Operations keeps the current list.

8. Equipment
Every employee receives a company laptop. Laptops must use full-disk encryption and must not be
lent to anyone, including family members. Lost or stolen equipment must be reported as a security
incident (see section 12).

9. Expenses and travel
Expense claims are submitted in Ledgerly within 30 days of the expense, with a receipt.
- Meals while travelling: up to 45 GBP per day.
- Hotels: up to 160 GBP per night in London and 110 GBP per night elsewhere.
- Rail travel: standard class, unless the journey is longer than 3 hours, in which case first
class may be booked.
- Using your own car: 45 pence per mile.
Flights must be booked through the travel desk and approved by your manager beforehand.

10. Learning and development
Each employee has a learning budget of 1,200 GBP per year for courses, books, certifications and
conferences. Unused budget does not carry over. Requests above 500 GBP need your manager's approval.
Everyone can also take 3 learning days per year, in addition to annual leave.

11. Probation, reviews and leaving
New employees have a probation period of 6 months. During probation, the notice period on either
side is 1 month. After probation, the notice period is 2 months, unless your contract says
otherwise. Performance reviews take place twice a year, in April and October.

12. Security incidents
Report any suspected security incident, including phishing emails, lost devices or data sent to
the wrong person, to security@brightwell.example within 1 hour of noticing it. Do not try to
investigate on your own and do not delete evidence. The Security team is available around the clock.

13. Raising concerns
If you have a concern about how you are treated at work, talk to your manager first. If that is
not possible, contact People Operations. Concerns can also be raised anonymously through the
Speak Up line, which is run by an independent provider.

# Brightwell Analytics — Information Classification and Data Retention Policy

*Policy owner: Daniel Okoro, Chief Information Security Officer. Approved by the Board on 12 January 2026.
Reviewed every year.*

> Fictional sample data written for DocQuery. Brightwell Analytics and the people named here do not exist.

## 1. Purpose and scope

This policy explains how Brightwell classifies information and how long it keeps it. It applies to all
employees, contractors and suppliers who handle Brightwell information, in any format and on any device.

## 2. Classification levels

| Level | Examples | Handling |
|---|---|---|
| Public | Marketing material, published reports | No restrictions |
| Internal | Handbook, team plans, internal wikis | Employees and contractors only |
| Confidential | Customer data, contracts, salaries | Need-to-know access, encrypted in transit and at rest |
| Restricted | Security keys, incident reports, M&A plans | Named individuals only, approved by the CISO |

When in doubt, classify information as **Confidential** until its owner decides otherwise.

## 3. Retention periods

When in doubt, classify information as **Confidential** until its owner decides otherwise.

## 3. Retention periods

- Customer data is deleted **90 days after the end of the customer's contract**, unless the customer asks for earlier deletion.
- Access and audit logs are kept for **13 months**.
- Invoices and accounting records are kept for **7 years**, as required by law.
- CVs and interview notes of unsuccessful candidates are deleted **6 months** after the hiring decision.
- Backups are kept for **35 days** and then overwritten.

## 4. Passwords and access

- Passwords must be at least **14 characters** long. Passphrases are encouraged.
- Multi-factor authentication is required for every company system that supports it.
- Access rights are reviewed every quarter by each system owner.

## 5. Exceptions

Exceptions to this policy must be requested in writing and approved by the CISO. Approved exceptions
are recorded in the risk register and expire after 12 months.

Lumen Hub 300 - User Manual
Smart home controller by Corvid Devices. Manual revision C, firmware 3.8.

The Lumen Hub 300, Corvid Devices and everything in this manual are fictional sample data written
for DocQuery. They do not describe a real product.

1. Overview
The Lumen Hub 300 connects your lights, sensors, locks and thermostats and lets you control them
from the Lumen app, even when you are away from home. Automations run on the hub itself, so they
keep working during an internet outage.

2. In the box
- Lumen Hub 300
- USB-C power adapter (5 V, 2 A) and 1.5 m cable
- Wall mounting plate and two screws
- Quick start card

3. Technical specifications
Radios: Zigbee 3.0, Thread 1.3 and Wi-Fi 6 (2.4 and 5 GHz). Bluetooth LE is used for setup only.
Capacity: up to 128 paired devices.
Power: 5 V, 2 A over USB-C. Typical consumption: 1.8 W.
Size and weight: 98 x 98 x 24 mm, 180 g.
Operating conditions: 0 to 40 degrees Celsius, indoor use only, 10 to 85 % humidity.

4. Setting up the hub
1. Download the Lumen app and create an account.
2. Plug in the hub. The status light pulses white while it starts, which takes about one minute.
3. In the app, tap Add hub and scan the QR code on the bottom of the hub.
4. Choose your Wi-Fi network. The hub only joins networks protected with WPA2 or WPA3.
Pairing mode for new devices lasts 120 seconds. To start it again, press the pair button once.

5. Status light
- Solid green: the hub is online and working normally.
- Pulsing white: the hub is starting.
- Pulsing blue: pairing mode is on.
- Pulsing amber: the hub is not set up yet or is waiting for Wi-Fi details.
- Solid red: the hub has no network connection.
- Flashing red: a firmware update failed (see error E37).

6. Resetting the hub
To restart the hub, hold the reset button for 10 seconds; your settings are kept.
To restore factory settings, hold the reset button for 30 seconds until the light turns amber.
A factory reset removes all paired devices and automations.

7. Troubleshooting and error codes
Error codes are shown in the Lumen app under Hub > Diagnostics.

E14 - Zigbee radio not responding. Unplug the hub for 30 seconds and plug it in again. If the error
comes back, contact Corvid support; the hub may need to be replaced under warranty.

E21 - Wi-Fi authentication failed. The Wi-Fi password was rejected. Check the password in the app,
then make sure the network uses WPA2 or WPA3.

E37 - Firmware signature invalid. The downloaded update could not be verified and was not installed.
Do not unplug the hub. It restores the previous firmware automatically and retries the update after
one hour. If E37 appears three times in a row, contact Corvid support.

E52 - Device limit reached. The hub already has 128 paired devices. Remove devices you no longer use
before pairing new ones.

Devices drop off the network: move the hub to a central, raised position away from metal objects and
microwave ovens, and add mains-powered Zigbee devices, which act as repeaters.

8. Updates
Firmware updates are released about once a month and install automatically between 02:00 and 05:00
local time. You can postpone an update by up to 7 days in the app.

9. Warranty
The Lumen Hub 300 has a 2-year limited warranty from the date of purchase. If you register the hub
in the Lumen app within 30 days of purchase, the warranty is extended to 3 years. The warranty does
not cover water damage, damage caused by opening the case, or use with a power adapter other than
the one supplied.

10. Support
Corvid support is available by chat in the Lumen app, Monday to Saturday, 08:00 to 20:00.
Have your hub's serial number ready; it is printed next to the QR code.

11. Safety
Do not cover the hub or install it near a heat source. Keep it away from water. Children should not
play with the hub or its cable.
